name: What tools are typically required for lever style kitchen faucet installation?

mainEntity.name: What tools are typically required for lever style kitchen faucet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For basic lever style kitchen faucet installation, common tools include an adjustable wrench or basin wrench for hard-to-reach nuts, a screwdriver (Phillips and flathead), a bucket or towels to catch drips, and plumber's putty or silicone sealant. You might also need a utility knife for cutting sealant or a flashlight for better visibility under the sink. Specialized tools like a pipe cutter or tubing bender are only needed if significant plumbing modifications are required.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential tools include an adjustable wrench, screwdrivers, a bucket, and plumber's putty; specialized tools may be needed for complex jobs.
